constellations.desc: When Varka switches to {LINK#N11280001}<color=#FFD780FF>Sturm und Drang</color>{/LINK}, he will obtain an additional use of the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color>{/LINK}.\nAdditionally, after switching to <color=#FFD780FF>Sturm und Drang</color>, Varka will gain the <color=#FFD780FF>Lyrical Libation</color> effect: When unleashing the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color>, or when performing the special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Devour</color>, Varka will consume this effect to deal 200% of the original DMG dealt by <color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color> or <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Devour</color>.
constellations.name: "Come, Friend, Let Us Dance Beneath the Moon's Soft Glow"

constellations.desc: When unleashing the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color>{/LINK}, or when performing the special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Devour</color>, Varka will perform an additional strike, dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>AoE Anemo DMG</color> equal to 800% of Varka's ATK.
constellations.name: "When Dawn Breaks, Our Journey Shall Take Flight"

constellations.desc: Increases Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11282}Windbound Execution{/LINK}</color> Level by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: "O Friend, Quaff Not the Bitter Wine That Brings Tears of Woe"

constellations.desc: When Varka triggers a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction, based on the Elemental Types involved in the reaction, all nearby party members gain a 20% <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG Bonus</color> and the corresponding Elemental DMG Bonus for 10s.
constellations.name: "For None May Take From Us Our Freedom of Song"

constellations.desc: Increases Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11285}Northwind Avatar{/LINK}</color> Level by 3.\n Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: "Fill High the Cup With Fine Wine, for Tyrants Come and Go"

constellations.desc:
{LINK#N11280001}<color=#FFD780FF>Sturm und Drang</color>{/LINK} is enhanced:
· For a short time after unleashing the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color>{/LINK}, Tapping on Varka's Elemental Skill or Holding his Normal Attack will not expend any uses of Four Winds' Ascension, and will perform one additional instance of the special Charged Attack, <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Devour</color>.
· For a short time after performing the special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Devour</color>, tap on Varka's Elemental Skill to unleash an additional instance of <color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color> without expending any uses of Four Winds' Ascension.
When triggering an additional special Charged Attack, Azure Devour, or unleashing an additional special Elemental Skill, Four Winds' Ascension, in this manner, the above effect cannot be triggered.

Additionally, the <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Fang's Oath</color> effect in Ascension Talent <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#P1282201}Wind's Vanguard{/LINK}</color> is enhanced: Every stack of <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Fang's Oath</color> will increase Varka's CRIT DMG by 20%.
constellations.name: "Beloved Mondstadt, Steadfast You Shall Shine"

passives.desc: When there are <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>, <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>, <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color> or <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> characters in the party, according to the aforementioned priority order of Elemental Types, every 1,000 points of Varka's ATK will grant Varka a 10% <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG Bonus</color> and corresponding Elemental DMG Bonus (among the aforementioned Elemental Types, only one element can gain bonus DMG this way). Up to 25% bonus DMG can be gained this way. \n\nAdditionally, if there are at least 2 <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo</color> characters, or at least 2 characters of the same Element among <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>, <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>, <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color> or <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> in the party, the Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, Special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Devour</color> and the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color>{/LINK} that Varka deals or unleashes while in the {LINK#N11280001}<color=#FFD780FF>Sturm und Drang</color>{/LINK} mode will deal 140% of their original DMG. If there are at least 2 <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo</color> characters and at least 2 other characters of the same element among <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>, <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>, <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color> or <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> present in the party at the same time, the aforementioned effect will be increased to 220%.
passives.name: Dawn Wind's March

passives.desc: When nearby party members trigger a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction, Varka gains 1 stack of <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Fang's Oath</color>, increasing the DMG dealt by his Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Devour</color> and special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color>{/LINK} by 7.5% for 8s. Max 4 stacks. Each character can grant Varka with 1 stack of <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Fang's Oath</color> every second this way.
passives.name: Wind's Vanguard

passives.desc: For every party member from Mondstadt, the Hold version of Varka's Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Windbound Execution</color>'s CD is decreased by 5%.\nThis effect does not trigger in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.
passives.name: Homebound Wind's Paean

passives.desc:
After completing <color=#FFD780FF>Witch's Homework: The Untitled Question</color>, Varka will become a <color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei</color> character. When the party includes at least 2 Hexerei characters, you will gain the <color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei: Secret Rite</color> effect, which enhances Hexerei characters.

<color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei: Secret Rite</color>
Enhances the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color>{/LINK}: When Varka hits an opponent with Normal Attack(s) in {LINK#N11280001}<color=#FFD780FF>Sturm und Drang</color>{/LINK}, the CD of <color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color> will be reduced by 1s.
passives.name: Witch's Eve Rite: Dawn's Return

skills.desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Imitating an ancient knightly war-dance, Varka wields dual claymores to perform up to 5 consecutive strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to charge forward and perform an especially powerful dual blade slash toward the front.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
skills.name: Favonius Bladework: Dancing Radiance

skills.desc:
Manifest the true essence of Favonius Bladework with absolute power. Produces different effects depending on whether the skill is Tapped or Held.

<color=#FFD780FF>Tap</color>
Leap forward and slash in one fluid motion, dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>AoE Anemo DMG</color> and switching to {LINK#N11280001}<color=#FFD780FF>Sturm und Drang</color>{/LINK} mode.
While in <color=#FFD780FF>Sturm und Drang</color>, Varka's Normal Attack and Charged Attack DMG is increased, and he cannot perform Plunging Attacks. Also, when performing Normal or Charged Attacks, Varka's dual-wielded claymores will deal corresponding Elemental DMG based on the Elemental Types of the characters in the party, respectively. This Elemental DMG cannot be overridden by infusions.
Additionally, when in <color=#FFD780FF>Sturm und Drang</color>, if there are <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>, <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>, <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color> or <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> characters in the party, Varka's Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Windbound Execution</color> will be converted to the special Elemental Skill, {LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color>{/LINK}, dealing corresponding Elemental DMG and <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color>. Additionally, Varka can also expend uses of the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color> to perform a special Charged Attack, <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Devour</color>, that does not consume stamina to deal corresponding Elemental DMG and <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Hold</color>
After charging for a while, leap forward. The duration of the charge will increase the distance of the leap.
skills.name: Windbound Execution

hyperlinks.description:
Tap to unleash Elemental Skill Windbound Execution for Varka to switch to this mode.
While in this mode, Varka's Normal Attacks and Charged Attacks deal increased DMG, and he cannot perform Plunging Attacks. When Varka executes Normal or Charged Attacks, his dual-wielded claymores will deal corresponding Elemental DMG based on the Elemental Types of the characters in the party respectively:
· DMG dealt by the claymore wielded in his left hand will be converted to Anemo DMG that cannot be overridden by other infusions.
· When there are Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo characters in the party, the claymore wielded in his right hand deals corresponding Elemental DMG that cannot be overridden by infusions, following the aforementioned priority order of Elemental Types.

Additionally, while in this mode, if there are Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo characters in the party, Varka's Elemental Skill Windbound Execution will be converted to the special Elemental Skill, Four Winds' Ascension.
hyperlinks.name: Sturm und Drang

hyperlinks.description:
Varka's special Elemental Skill. Deals AoE Elemental DMG that cannot be overridden by infusions corresponding to the element of the claymore wielded in Varka's right hand, and AoE Anemo DMG to opponents.
Starts on cooldown and has 2 maximum uses.
When Varka is in Sturm und Drang mode and his Normal Attack hits an opponent, the CD of Four Winds' Ascension will be reduced by 0.5s. Every time Varka switches to the Sturm und Drang mode, this effect can be triggered up to 15 times.
Additionally, Varka can expend uses of Four Winds' Ascension to perform a special Charged Attack, Azure Devour, that consumes no Stamina, dealing 2 instances of Elemental DMG corresponding to the element of the claymore wielded in his right hand, which cannot be overridden by infusions, and 2 instances of Anemo DMG.
hyperlinks.name: Four Winds' Ascension

If there are Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo characters in the party, the first slash will be converted to deal corresponding Elemental DMG according to the aforementioned priority order of Elemental Types. "Hey, Seamus, have you ever thought it weird that I, the Knight of Boreas, North of Mondstadt's Four Winds, am the Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius, the West of Mondstadt's Four Winds? If, let's say, I want to threaten the enemy with some harsh words... Should I say 'I am the North Wind' or 'I am the West Wind'? Or better yet, 'I am the Northwest Wind'?" "Firstly, the Wild Hunt cannot understand what you're saying. Secondly, they're less than three hundred meters away from us right now. Please focus on more pressing matters, Grand Master Varka."

const6.description:
{LINK#N11280001}<color=#FFD780FF>狂飙突进</color>{/LINK}模式获得强化：
·施放特殊元素战技{LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>四风将起</color>{/LINK}后的短暂时间内，法尔伽可以点按元素战技或长按普通攻击，不消耗四风将起的可用次数，进行一次额外的特殊重击<color=#FFD780FF>苍噬</color>；
·进行特殊重击<color=#FFD780FF>苍噬</color>后的短暂时间内，法尔伽可以点按元素战技，不消耗四风将起的可用次数，施放一次额外的<color=#FFD780FF>四风将起</color>。
通过上述方式进行额外的特殊重击苍噬或施放额外的特殊元素战技四风将起时，无法触发上述效果。

此外，突破天赋<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#P1282201}「风帜的先引」{/LINK}</color>中<color=#FFD780FF>「苍牙之誓」</color>的效果获得强化：每层<color=#FFD780FF>「苍牙之誓」</color>还会使法尔伽的暴击伤害提升20%。
const6.name: 「我心爱的蒙德呀，依然屹立如初」

hyperlinks.description:
点按施放元素战技烈风终坠后，法尔伽将切换至该模式。
处于该模式下时，法尔伽的普通攻击与重击造成的伤害提高，无法进行下落攻击；法尔伽进行普通攻击与重击时，将根据队伍中角色的元素类型，使双持的大剑分别造成无法被附魔覆盖的对应元素伤害：
·左手持握的大剑将转为造成无法被附魔覆盖的风元素伤害；
·队伍中存在火元素、水元素、雷元素或冰元素角色时，右手持握的大剑将按照上述元素类型的优先级，造成无法被附魔覆盖的对应元素伤害。

此外，处于该模式下时，若队伍中存在火元素、水元素、雷元素或冰元素角色，法尔伽的元素战技烈风终坠将会被替换为特殊的元素战技四风将起。
hyperlinks.name: 狂飙突进

hyperlinks.description:
法尔伽的特殊元素战技，对敌人造成无法被附魔覆盖的右手持握大剑的对应元素范围伤害与风元素范围伤害。
初始处于冷却，至多拥有2次可使用次数。
法尔伽在狂飙突进模式下的普通攻击命中敌人时，四风将起的冷却时间将会缩短0.5秒；每次切换至狂飙突进模式后，该效果至多触发15次。
此外，法尔伽可以消耗四风将起的可使用次数，进行不消耗体力的特殊重击苍噬，造成2次无法被附魔覆盖的右手持握大剑的对应元素伤害与2次风元素伤害。
hyperlinks.name: 四风将起

info.description: 西风骑士团大团长，守护蒙德的北风骑士。
info.name: 法尔伽
info.title: 北风骑士

p1.description: 队伍中存在<color=#FF9999FF>火元素</color>、<color=#80C0FFFF>水元素</color>、<color=#FFACFFFF>雷元素</color>或<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素</color>角色时，按照上述元素类型的优先级，基于法尔伽的攻击力，每1000点攻击力都将使法尔伽获得10%<color=#80FFD7FF>风元素伤害加成</color>与对应元素伤害加成（上述元素类型中，至多有一种元素类型可以通过这种方式获得伤害加成），至多通过这种方式获得25%。\n\n此外，如果队伍中存在至少2名<color=#80FFD7FF>风元素</color>角色，或存在至少2名元素类型相同的<color=#FF9999FF>火元素</color>、<color=#80C0FFFF>水元素</color>、<color=#FFACFFFF>雷元素</color>或<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素</color>角色，法尔伽在{LINK#N11280001}<color=#FFD780FF>狂飙突进</color>{/LINK}模式下进行的普通攻击、重击、特殊重击<color=#FFD780FF>苍噬</color>与施放的特殊元素战技{LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>四风将起</color>{/LINK}将造成原本140%的伤害；若队伍中同时存在至少2名<color=#80FFD7FF>风元素</color>角色与至少2名元素类型相同的<color=#FF9999FF>火元素</color>、<color=#80C0FFFF>水元素</color>、<color=#FFACFFFF>雷元素</color>或<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素</color>角色，则会使上述效果提升至220%。
p1.name: 晓风的行军

p2.description: 队伍中附近的角色触发扩散或星扩散反应时，法尔伽将获得一层<color=#FFD780FF>「苍牙之誓」</color>，使法尔伽的普通攻击、重击、特殊重击<color=#FFD780FF>苍噬</color>与施放的特殊元素战技{LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>四风将起</color>{/LINK}造成的伤害提升7.5%。该效果持续8秒，至多叠加4层，每名角色每1秒至多通过这种方式使法尔伽获得一层<color=#FFD780FF>「苍牙之誓」</color>。
p2.name: 风帜的先引

p3.description: 队伍中每有一名蒙德角色，通过长按施放的元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>烈风终坠</color>的冷却时间就会缩短5%。\n该效果在秘境、征讨领域、深境螺旋中无效。
p3.name: 归风的凯歌

p4.description:
完成<color=#FFD780FF>魔女的课业·无题之题</color>后，法尔伽将成为<color=#FFD780FF>魔导</color>角色。队伍中编入至少2名魔导角色时，将获得<color=#FFD780FF>魔导·秘仪</color>效果，使魔导角色获得强化。

<color=#FFD780FF>魔导·秘仪</color>
特殊元素战技{LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>四风将起</color>{/LINK}获得强化：法尔伽在{LINK#N11280001}<color=#FFD780FF>狂飙突进</color>{/LINK}模式下的普通攻击命中敌人时，<color=#FFD780FF>四风将起</color>的冷却时间将会转为缩短1秒。
p4.name: 魔女的前夜礼·重光临晨

elementalburst.description: 以最强的北风骑士之名，向前方挥出强力的二连斩，造成两次风元素伤害。 若队伍中存在火元素、水元素、雷元素或冰元素角色，则第一次斩击将会按照上述元素类型的优先级，转为造成对应元素伤害。 「西蒙啊，你仔细想想，我身为『北风』骑士，却在担任『西风』骑士团的大团长，会不会很奇怪？比方说，要是想对敌人抛狠话，是该说『我即北风』呢，还是『我即西风』呢，还是『我即西北风』呢？」 「首先，狂猎听不懂您在说什么。其次，狂猎已经距离我们不到三百米了，请您先思考一些更正经的事，法尔伽团长。」
elementalburst.name: 我即朔风

elementalskill.description: 以绝对的力量，呈现西风剑术的真髓，依据点按、长按，以不同的方式产生效果。 点按 向前方腾跃而起并顺势劈斩，造成风元素范围伤害，并切换至{LINK#N11280001}狂飙突进{/LINK}模式。 处于狂飙突进模式下时，法尔伽的普通攻击与重击造成的伤害提高，无法进行下落攻击，且进行普通攻击与重击时，将根据队伍中角色的元素类型，使双持的大剑分别造成无法被附魔覆盖的对应元素伤害。 此外，处于狂飙突进模式下时，若队伍中存在火元素、水元素、雷元素或冰元素角色，法尔伽的元素战技烈风终坠将会被替换为特殊的元素战技{LINK#N11280002}四风将起{/LINK}，造成对应元素伤害与风元素伤害；此外，法尔伽还可以消耗特殊元素战技四风将起的可使用次数，进行不消耗体力的特殊重击苍噬，造成对应元素伤害与风元素伤害。 长按 进行蓄力后，向前方腾跃而起，蓄力时间会提升腾跃距离。 「风不惧怕明天，不惧怕锁链。监牢与高墙禁锢不住风，也禁锢不住为自由而歌唱的人们。」 「说得好，但这句话的意思不是说您可以在被琴关禁闭的时候逃到猫尾酒馆奖励自己喝酒，法尔伽团长。」
elementalskill.name: 烈风终坠

normalattack.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>普通攻击</color>
仿拟古代骑士的战舞，双持大剑进行至多五段的连续攻击。

<color=#FFD780FF>重击</color>
消耗一定体力，向前方突进后，进行一次格外有力的双剑挥砍。

<color=#FFD780FF>下落攻击</color>
从空中下坠冲击地面，攻击下落路径上的敌人，并在落地时造成范围伤害。
normalattack.name: 西风剑术·流光之舞

constellations.desc: When Varka switches to {LINK#N11280001}<color=#FFD780FF>Sturm und Drang</color>{/LINK}, he will obtain an additional use of the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color>{/LINK}.\nAdditionally, after switching to <color=#FFD780FF>Sturm und Drang</color>, Varka will gain the <color=#FFD780FF>Lyrical Libation</color> effect: When unleashing the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color>, or when performing the special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Devour</color>, Varka will consume this effect to deal 200% of the original DMG dealt by <color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color> or <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Devour</color>.
constellations.name: "Come, Friend, Let Us Dance Beneath the Moon's Soft Glow"

constellations.desc: When unleashing the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color>{/LINK}, or when performing the special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Devour</color>, Varka will perform an additional strike, dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>AoE Anemo DMG</color> equal to 800% of Varka's ATK.
constellations.name: "When Dawn Breaks, Our Journey Shall Take Flight"

constellations.desc: Increases Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11282}Windbound Execution{/LINK}</color> Level by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: "O Friend, Quaff Not the Bitter Wine That Brings Tears of Woe"

constellations.desc: When Varka triggers a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction, based on the Elemental Types involved in the reaction, all nearby party members gain a 20% <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG Bonus</color> and the corresponding Elemental DMG Bonus for 10s.
constellations.name: "For None May Take From Us Our Freedom of Song"

constellations.desc: Increases Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11285}Northwind Avatar{/LINK}</color> Level by 3.\n Maximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: "Fill High the Cup With Fine Wine, for Tyrants Come and Go"

constellations.desc:
{LINK#N11280001}<color=#FFD780FF>Sturm und Drang</color>{/LINK} is enhanced:
· For a short time after unleashing the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color>{/LINK}, Tapping on Varka's Elemental Skill or Holding his Normal Attack will not expend any uses of Four Winds' Ascension, and will perform one additional instance of the special Charged Attack, <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Devour</color>.
· For a short time after performing the special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Devour</color>, tap on Varka's Elemental Skill to unleash an additional instance of <color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color> without expending any uses of Four Winds' Ascension.
When triggering an additional special Charged Attack, Azure Devour, or unleashing an additional special Elemental Skill, Four Winds' Ascension, in this manner, the above effect cannot be triggered.

Additionally, the <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Fang's Oath</color> effect in Ascension Talent <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#P1282201}Wind's Vanguard{/LINK}</color> is enhanced: Every stack of <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Fang's Oath</color> will increase Varka's CRIT DMG by 20%.
constellations.name: "Beloved Mondstadt, Steadfast You Shall Shine"

passives.desc: When there are <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>, <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>, <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color> or <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> characters in the party, according to the aforementioned priority order of Elemental Types, every 1,000 points of Varka's ATK will grant Varka a 10% <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG Bonus</color> and corresponding Elemental DMG Bonus (among the aforementioned Elemental Types, only one element can gain bonus DMG this way). Up to 25% bonus DMG can be gained this way. \n\nAdditionally, if there are at least 2 <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo</color> characters, or at least 2 characters of the same Element among <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>, <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>, <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color> or <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> in the party, the Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, Special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Devour</color> and the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color>{/LINK} that Varka deals or unleashes while in the {LINK#N11280001}<color=#FFD780FF>Sturm und Drang</color>{/LINK} mode will deal 140% of their original DMG. If there are at least 2 <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo</color> characters and at least 2 other characters of the same element among <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>, <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>, <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color> or <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> present in the party at the same time, the aforementioned effect will be increased to 220%.
passives.name: Dawn Wind's March

passives.desc: When nearby party members trigger a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction, Varka gains 1 stack of <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Fang's Oath</color>, increasing the DMG dealt by his Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Devour</color> and special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color>{/LINK} by 7.5% for 8s. Max 4 stacks. Each character can grant Varka with 1 stack of <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Fang's Oath</color> every second this way.
passives.name: Wind's Vanguard

passives.desc: For every party member from Mondstadt, the Hold version of Varka's Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Windbound Execution</color>'s CD is decreased by 5%.\nThis effect does not trigger in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.
passives.name: Homebound Wind's Paean

passives.desc:
After completing <color=#FFD780FF>Witch's Homework: The Untitled Question</color>, Varka will become a <color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei</color> character. When the party includes at least 2 Hexerei characters, you will gain the <color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei: Secret Rite</color> effect, which enhances Hexerei characters.

<color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei: Secret Rite</color>
Enhances the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color>{/LINK}: When Varka hits an opponent with Normal Attack(s) in {LINK#N11280001}<color=#FFD780FF>Sturm und Drang</color>{/LINK}, the CD of <color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color> will be reduced by 1s.
passives.name: Witch's Eve Rite: Dawn's Return

skills.desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Imitating an ancient knightly war-dance, Varka wields dual claymores to perform up to 5 consecutive strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to charge forward and perform an especially powerful dual blade slash toward the front.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
skills.name: Favonius Bladework: Dancing Radiance

skills.desc:
Manifest the true essence of Favonius Bladework with absolute power. Produces different effects depending on whether the skill is Tapped or Held.

<color=#FFD780FF>Tap</color>
Leap forward and slash in one fluid motion, dealing <color=#80FFD7FF>AoE Anemo DMG</color> and switching to {LINK#N11280001}<color=#FFD780FF>Sturm und Drang</color>{/LINK} mode.
While in <color=#FFD780FF>Sturm und Drang</color>, Varka's Normal Attack and Charged Attack DMG is increased, and he cannot perform Plunging Attacks. Also, when performing Normal or Charged Attacks, Varka's dual-wielded claymores will deal corresponding Elemental DMG based on the Elemental Types of the characters in the party, respectively. This Elemental DMG cannot be overridden by infusions.
Additionally, when in <color=#FFD780FF>Sturm und Drang</color>, if there are <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>, <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>, <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color> or <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> characters in the party, Varka's Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Windbound Execution</color> will be converted to the special Elemental Skill, {LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color>{/LINK}, dealing corresponding Elemental DMG and <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color>. Additionally, Varka can also expend uses of the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Four Winds' Ascension</color> to perform a special Charged Attack, <color=#FFD780FF>Azure Devour</color>, that does not consume stamina to deal corresponding Elemental DMG and <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Hold</color>
After charging for a while, leap forward. The duration of the charge will increase the distance of the leap.
skills.name: Windbound Execution

skills.desc: In the name of the mightiest Knight of Boreas, unleash a powerful double slash attack toward the front, dealing 2 instances of <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color>.\nIf there are <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>, <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>, <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color> or <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> characters in the party, the first slash will be converted to deal corresponding Elemental DMG according to the aforementioned priority order of Elemental Types.
skills.name: Northwind Avatar

constellations.desc: 法尔伽切换至{LINK#N11280001}<color=#FFD780FF>狂飙突进</color>{/LINK}模式时，将额外获得一次特殊元素战技{LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>四风将起</color>{/LINK}的可用次数。\n此外，切换至<color=#FFD780FF>狂飙突进</color>模式后，法尔伽将获得<color=#FFD780FF>「歌中的佳酿」</color>效果：施放特殊元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>四风将起</color>时，或进行特殊重击<color=#FFD780FF>苍噬</color>时，将消耗该效果，使<color=#FFD780FF>四风将起</color>或<color=#FFD780FF>苍噬</color>造成原本200%的伤害。
constellations.name: 「来吧，朋友，让我们在月下共舞」

constellations.desc: 施放特殊元素战技{LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>四风将起</color>{/LINK}时，或进行特殊重击<color=#FFD780FF>苍噬</color>时，法尔伽将会进行一次额外攻击，造成800%攻击力的<color=#80FFD7FF>风元素范围伤害</color>。
constellations.name: 「待天光破晓，我们便要踏上征途」

constellations.desc: 元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11282}烈风终坠{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
constellations.name: 「朋友，莫要再饮令人落泪的苦酒」

constellations.desc: 法尔伽触发扩散或星扩散反应时，依据参与反应的元素类型，使队伍中附近的所有角色分别获得20%<color=#80FFD7FF>风元素伤害加成</color>与对应元素伤害加成，持续10秒。
constellations.name: 「因为无人能夺去我们歌唱的自由」

constellations.desc: 元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11285}我即朔风{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
constellations.name: 「斟满杯中佳酿吧，暴君来了又去」

constellations.desc:
{LINK#N11280001}<color=#FFD780FF>狂飙突进</color>{/LINK}模式获得强化：
·施放特殊元素战技{LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>四风将起</color>{/LINK}后的短暂时间内，法尔伽可以点按元素战技或长按普通攻击，不消耗四风将起的可用次数，进行一次额外的特殊重击<color=#FFD780FF>苍噬</color>；
·进行特殊重击<color=#FFD780FF>苍噬</color>后的短暂时间内，法尔伽可以点按元素战技，不消耗四风将起的可用次数，施放一次额外的<color=#FFD780FF>四风将起</color>。
通过上述方式进行额外的特殊重击苍噬或施放额外的特殊元素战技四风将起时，无法触发上述效果。

此外，突破天赋<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#P1282201}「风帜的先引」{/LINK}</color>中<color=#FFD780FF>「苍牙之誓」</color>的效果获得强化：每层<color=#FFD780FF>「苍牙之誓」</color>还会使法尔伽的暴击伤害提升20%。
constellations.name: 「我心爱的蒙德呀，依然屹立如初」

passives.desc: 队伍中存在<color=#FF9999FF>火元素</color>、<color=#80C0FFFF>水元素</color>、<color=#FFACFFFF>雷元素</color>或<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素</color>角色时，按照上述元素类型的优先级，基于法尔伽的攻击力，每1000点攻击力都将使法尔伽获得10%<color=#80FFD7FF>风元素伤害加成</color>与对应元素伤害加成（上述元素类型中，至多有一种元素类型可以通过这种方式获得伤害加成），至多通过这种方式获得25%。\n\n此外，如果队伍中存在至少2名<color=#80FFD7FF>风元素</color>角色，或存在至少2名元素类型相同的<color=#FF9999FF>火元素</color>、<color=#80C0FFFF>水元素</color>、<color=#FFACFFFF>雷元素</color>或<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素</color>角色，法尔伽在{LINK#N11280001}<color=#FFD780FF>狂飙突进</color>{/LINK}模式下进行的普通攻击、重击、特殊重击<color=#FFD780FF>苍噬</color>与施放的特殊元素战技{LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>四风将起</color>{/LINK}将造成原本140%的伤害；若队伍中同时存在至少2名<color=#80FFD7FF>风元素</color>角色与至少2名元素类型相同的<color=#FF9999FF>火元素</color>、<color=#80C0FFFF>水元素</color>、<color=#FFACFFFF>雷元素</color>或<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素</color>角色，则会使上述效果提升至220%。
passives.name: 晓风的行军

passives.desc: 队伍中附近的角色触发扩散或星扩散反应时，法尔伽将获得一层<color=#FFD780FF>「苍牙之誓」</color>，使法尔伽的普通攻击、重击、特殊重击<color=#FFD780FF>苍噬</color>与施放的特殊元素战技{LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>四风将起</color>{/LINK}造成的伤害提升7.5%。该效果持续8秒，至多叠加4层，每名角色每1秒至多通过这种方式使法尔伽获得一层<color=#FFD780FF>「苍牙之誓」</color>。
passives.name: 风帜的先引

passives.desc: 队伍中每有一名蒙德角色，通过长按施放的元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>烈风终坠</color>的冷却时间就会缩短5%。\n该效果在秘境、征讨领域、深境螺旋中无效。
passives.name: 归风的凯歌

passives.desc:
完成<color=#FFD780FF>魔女的课业·无题之题</color>后，法尔伽将成为<color=#FFD780FF>魔导</color>角色。队伍中编入至少2名魔导角色时，将获得<color=#FFD780FF>魔导·秘仪</color>效果，使魔导角色获得强化。

<color=#FFD780FF>魔导·秘仪</color>
特殊元素战技{LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>四风将起</color>{/LINK}获得强化：法尔伽在{LINK#N11280001}<color=#FFD780FF>狂飙突进</color>{/LINK}模式下的普通攻击命中敌人时，<color=#FFD780FF>四风将起</color>的冷却时间将会转为缩短1秒。
passives.name: 魔女的前夜礼·重光临晨

skills.desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>普通攻击</color>
仿拟古代骑士的战舞，双持大剑进行至多五段的连续攻击。

<color=#FFD780FF>重击</color>
消耗一定体力，向前方突进后，进行一次格外有力的双剑挥砍。

<color=#FFD780FF>下落攻击</color>
从空中下坠冲击地面，攻击下落路径上的敌人，并在落地时造成范围伤害。
skills.name: 西风剑术·流光之舞

skills.desc:
以绝对的力量，呈现西风剑术的真髓，依据点按、长按，以不同的方式产生效果。

<color=#FFD780FF>点按</color>
向前方腾跃而起并顺势劈斩，造成<color=#80FFD7FF>风元素范围伤害</color>，并切换至{LINK#N11280001}<color=#FFD780FF>狂飙突进</color>{/LINK}模式。
处于<color=#FFD780FF>狂飙突进</color>模式下时，法尔伽的普通攻击与重击造成的伤害提高，无法进行下落攻击，且进行普通攻击与重击时，将根据队伍中角色的元素类型，使双持的大剑分别造成无法被附魔覆盖的对应元素伤害。
此外，处于<color=#FFD780FF>狂飙突进</color>模式下时，若队伍中存在<color=#FF9999FF>火元素</color>、<color=#80C0FFFF>水元素</color>、<color=#FFACFFFF>雷元素</color>或<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素</color>角色，法尔伽的元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>烈风终坠</color>将会被替换为特殊的元素战技{LINK#N11280002}<color=#FFD780FF>四风将起</color>{/LINK}，造成对应元素伤害与<color=#80FFD7FF>风元素伤害</color>；此外，法尔伽还可以消耗特殊元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>四风将起</color>的可使用次数，进行不消耗体力的特殊重击<color=#FFD780FF>苍噬</color>，造成对应元素伤害与<color=#80FFD7FF>风元素伤害</color>。

<color=#FFD780FF>长按</color>
进行蓄力后，向前方腾跃而起，蓄力时间会提升腾跃距离。
skills.name: 烈风终坠

skills.desc: 以最强的北风骑士之名，向前方挥出强力的二连斩，造成两次<color=#80FFD7FF>风元素伤害</color>。\n若队伍中存在<color=#FF9999FF>火元素</color>、<color=#80C0FFFF>水元素</color>、<color=#FFACFFFF>雷元素</color>或<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素</color>角色，则第一次斩击将会按照上述元素类型的优先级，转为造成对应元素伤害。
skills.name: 我即朔风
